name: Playwright
description: Drive a real browser: open pages, click through flows, read what is on screen.
long_description:
Microsoft's Playwright server, run as a local process. It opens a page, clicks through a flow, reads the accessibility tree and takes screenshots — so the agent can check a page rather than guess at it.

It runs on your machine, with your network, and the first run downloads a browser if Playwright has none.

risk.notes: Runs a browser on this machine and visits whatever it is pointed at.
